CustomObject.description: Published when a supplier's own compliance status changes (Account.Risk_Tier__c changes, driven by a Compliance_Assessment__c/document status change). Subscribed by SupplierRiskChangeTrigger, which drives MultiTierRollupService in real time (not a batch job) so the cascading risk SCORE and worst-case tier recompute bottom-up from the changed supplier to Tier 1.
CustomObject.label: Supplier Risk Change
